title: Tangerine Logistics on-prem playbook (raw)
content:
Context:
- Customer: Tangerine Logistics (regional 3PL, 42 warehouses across NA). Interested in private, on-prem Redwood runtime to power warehouse assistance (picking suggestions, incident summarization, voice-to-text QA) with occasional offline windows.
- Primary ask: enclosed private deployment (air-gapped optional for some sites), predictable tail latency for short prompts (<= 200 tokens), throughput for peak: ~120 reqs/sec aggregated, per-site peak ~6 rps.

Call summary (2025-11-19 sync with CTO + SRE lead):
- CTO (R. Kwan): wants predictable unit economics and absolute control of PII flows. Willing to provision pockets of GPU at larger hubs, but many smaller sites will be CPU-only inference.
- SRE (A. Bell): network is flaky at two east-coast DCs (scheduled brownouts), wants automatic local fallback to low-cost quantized model when KV cache cold or NPU not available.
- WMS lead (D. Marquez): integration point = LoadStream API v3.1 (webhook push for pick-tasks). Wants <150ms server-side time added to his API call chain for 95th percentile.

Key technical constraints / gotchas noticed:
- Many sites run on private VLANs behind Palo Alto NGFWs; outbound to Redwood managed control-plane is allowed but must go through corporate proxy. We will need explicit egress IP list and proxy auth guidance.
- Air-gapped sites: expect manual image deployment cadence (monthly). No external KMS — they use HSM appliance (nCipher) locally; must support local key unwrap or integrate with agent-based HSM adapter.
- Hardware heterogeneity: 8 sites have A100/80GB spare; 7 have T4-class GPUs; rest are either CPU-only (16–24 vCPUs) or Intel+NPU devices. Need variant model packaging: FP16 on A100, int8 on T4, CPU quantized for CPU-only.
- Storage: on-site S3-compatible object store (MinIO) for KV snapshots. Must support prefix cache checkpointing to MinIO with fast restore.
- WMS requests are sensitive to ordering; cannot block pick confirmation for model cold-starts. Must do async enrichment and return immediately.

Performance targets discussed (customer wants numbers to hand to ops):
- 95th pct latency (short prompts, 128 tokens) <= 150ms for GPU-backed sites; <= 450ms for CPU sites (acceptable).
- Throughput: aggregate 120 req/s steady, with 2x spikes. Model warm caches expected to reduce token cost by ~20–40%.
- Cost sensitivity: CFO flagged monthly budget cap per site (avg) $1,500/mo for inference compute — we need sizing that shows dedicated vs. burst vs. fallback options.

Recommended deployment pattern (first-cut):
1) Pilot (3 sites): one A100 site (regional hub), one T4 mid-size site, one CPU-only peripheral. Purpose: validate fallback policy, KV snapshot/restore, and MinIO integration.
2) Model packaging: release 2 model variants initially — 'tangerine-lg' (FP16 on A100, int8 on T4) and 'tangerine-sm-cpu' (quantized CPU binary). Provide small transformer (1–4B) for edge inference to meet latency SLOs.
3) Control plane: managed Redwood control-plane with peered VPC egress for non-airgapped sites. Air-gapped sites use a packaged control-plane shim and local admin UI.
4) Secrets: integrate with local HSM for air-gapped sites; otherwise use KMS with envelope encryption and local cache of unwrapped keys in memory-only process.
5) Failover policy: primary = local GPU model; fallback = CPU quantized model; degraded = lightweight heuristic microservice that returns cached suggestions and marks hit/miss events to analytics.

Open questions / blockers (actionable):
- HSM adapter: can we ship a small agent that talks to nCipher via PKCS#11? (Action: eng-private-deploy to validate by 2025-12-05) — owner: Priya
- License for model variants: legal needs to confirm redistribution policy for chosen open model (Action: send candidate model list to legal by 2025-11-25) — owner: Maya
- Networking: need explicit list of control-plane egress IPs for Tangerine firewall team. (Action: infra to publish egress list and proxy config by 2025-11-27) — owner: Liam
- Metrics: WMS wants an API event when suggestion latency > 200ms; need to define webhook schema. (Action: product to propose webhook payload by 2025-12-02) — owner: Diego

Rough runbook checklist (pilot):
- [ ] Provision A100 node, install runtime, smoke test FP16 model (owner: eng-serving-runtime; ETA: 2025-12-12)
- [ ] Deploy MinIO connector and test KV snapshot/restore cycle (owner: platform-engineering; ETA: 2025-12-14)
- [ ] HSM integration smoke (owner: security & compliance; ETA: 2025-12-18)
- [ ] WMS webhook integration proof (owner: solutions-eng; ETA: 2025-12-08)
- [ ] Cost projection doc for CFO (owner: finance-and-legal + product; ETA: 2025-12-01)

Notes-to-self / quick heuristics observed on call:
- Push async enrichment model path: do not block LoadStream confirm call. Use correlation IDs pushed to Redis/MinIO for later reconciliation.
- KV cache warmups will be critical: for pick suggestions, user flows are repetitive — design pre-warm job when shift starts (cron) to load common prefixes.
- For CPU-only sites consider lighter headless model + token budget = 64 tokens to keep cost under $1k/mo/site.

Immediate next steps (this week):
- Send pilot plan + minimal hardware spec to Tangerine (Maya) — target: 2025-11-21
- Schedule 90-min workshop to map LoadStream events to suggestion payloads (Priya to lead) — target: 2025-11-25
- Open INF-4627 (JIRA) with the HSM integration spike and link to this doc (Liam)

Misc snippets / configs to capture here: 
- Example fallback policy (pseudo):
  IF GPU_AVAILABLE and KV_HIT==true -> route to local-gpu-model
  ELSE IF GPU_AVAILABLE and KV_HIT==false and LATENCY_EST < 200ms -> route to local-gpu-model (async prefetch)
  ELSE IF GPU_UNAVAILABLE -> route to local-cpu-quantized
  ELSE -> return cached suggestion with stale=true + enqueue async regenerate

- Minimal hardware spec for CPU-only site (ballpark):
  - 16 vCPU (2x8 cores), 64GB RAM, NVMe 1TB, 10GbE, local MinIO node for KV; OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS

Call takeaways (one-liners to share in follow-up email):
- Tangerine likes deterministic performance and local control; air-gap + HSM are hard constraints for a subset of sites.
- Start small with 3-site pilot to validate fallback, KV snapshot, and MinIO; build from there.
- Cost vs latency tradeoffs: propose 2 pricing profiles (dedicated hub + CPU-edge) for finance.

End of raw notes. Will tidy for runbook after pilot spec acceptance.
